title.en: Granting Year-End Bonus to National Government Officials and Employees Equivalent to One Week's Pay
title.orig: Granting Year-End Bonus to National Government Officials and Employees Equivalent to One Week's Pay

source.name: The LawPhil Project — Arellano Law Foundation
source.url: LawPhil (source has HTML full text only)

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自 LawPhil PDF 文本化成果（第三方 OCR，非机翻），原始文件 EO_00752_1981_html.txt

text.en:
All officials and employees of the National Government are entitled to the year-end bonus equivalent
to one week's basic pay.

Employees and officials already with a year-end bonus or incentive pay or equivalent beyond their
basic and duly authorized monthly allowance shall no longer be entitled to the year-end bonus.

Funds needed to implement this Order shall be drawn from salary savings. Any remaining deficiency
shall be charged against the Salary Adjustment Fund in the CY 1981 Appropriations Act. Any further
deficiency shall be charged against budgetary reserves.

The procedures, rules and regulations needed to carry out this Executive Order shall be formulated and
issued by the Office of Budget and Management.

The year-end bonus provided herein shall be effective immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 7th day of December, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
